Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Class DefaultKeyNamingStrategy

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.DefaultKeyNamingStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
KeyNamingStrategy
public class DefaultKeyNamingStrategy extends Object implements KeyNamingStrategy
Default implementation of KeyNamingStrategy using standard LangGraph4j key patterns.

This implementation uses the following key patterns:

  • Thread: langgraph4j:thread:{thread_id}
  • Thread name: langgraph4j:thread:name:{thread_name}:active
  • Checkpoint: langgraph4j:checkpoint:{checkpoint_id}
  • Checkpoints: langgraph4j:thread:{thread_id}:checkpoints
  • Key prefix: langgraph4j:
